note: L4 adds no native build and no new npm dependency. The arecord helper digest is host-measured (not in-image), the pinned CI image has no pinned digest and ships no alsa-utils, and there is no offline execution trace inside that image — so this receipt is partial, never a pass. Runtime enforcement (digest check at open, refuse on mismatch) is implemented in ArecordDevice and covered by unit tests.

toolchain.testImage: node:24-bookworm-slim (tag only; image digest not pinned — no lane exposes it, ad-hoc docker inspection is forbidden)
toolchain.nodeGyp: never invoked in live-speech install, build, test or device paths
toolchain.nativeBuild: none — no native module in the L4 path; faster-whisper-ts stays an optional L3 peer

packageDependencies.note: Zero runtime dependencies: device/capture/control import only node:child_process, node:crypto, node:fs and node builtins.

arecord.hostDigestScope: measured on the Ubuntu qualification host — NOT the node:24-bookworm-slim image, which ships no alsa-utils
arecord.imageDigest: pending — blocked: no lane provisions arecord inside the pinned image
arecord.license: GPL-2 (separate native executable, subprocess aggregation — same treatment as the L3 eSpeak NG binary)
arecord.invocation: arecord -D <id> -f S16_LE -r <rate> -c 1 -t raw (explicit argv, shell:false; stdout streamed as PCM, stderr drained as text, no audio files)
arecord.runtimeEnforcement: ArecordDevice.open resolves the binary to an absolute path, hashes it, and refuses anything outside ARECORD_SHA256_PINS plus constructor/ARECORD_DIGESTS allowlist (DeviceOpenError on mismatch; DeviceUnavailableError when missing)

pw-record.hostDigestScope: measured on the Ubuntu qualification host — NOT the node:24-bookworm-slim image
pw-record.imageDigest: pending — blocked: same provisioning gap as arecord
pw-record.license: package mix Expat/LGPL-2.1+ (see /usr/share/doc/pipewire-bin/copyright); subprocess aggregation only
